identity_evidence.quote: We report a case of a 24-year-old woman with a known history of SLE for three years

attribution_limitations: Duration and date of SLE are given in more than one form. The abstract says a known history of SLE for three years, while the case text says SLE was diagnosed in 2019 and the patient presented three years later; the year of presentation is not stated.

The discussion reports an abdominal ultrasound with patent hepatic veins, while the case presentation reports duplex ultrasonography of the hepatic and renal veins. The source does not say whether these are the same study.
The Figure 1 caption adds pulmonary infiltrates to the chest X-ray finding of bilateral pleural effusion, which the case text does not mention.
The furosemide infusion duration reads "for one hour for two days" and does not say whether the one-hour infusion was repeated daily.

Duplex ultrasonography was normal, CT showed no cancerous lesions, and ascitic fluid culture and tuberculosis PCR showed no infection, with no tumor cells found.
